           GALANTHUS NIVALIS

         Snow-drop


Proving by Dr. A. Whiting Vancouver.


Faintness, sinking sensations. Sore dry throat with dull headache. Half
        conscious and worried feeling during sleep. Heart weak with sensation of collapse as if she
        must fall. Pulse very irregular, rapid and uneven, violent palpitation. Systolic murmur at
        apex. Therapeutically-decided benefit in cases of Mitral Regurgitation with broken down
        compensation.   Myocarditis   with some degree of mitral
        insufficiency.



Dose.--  First potency to fifth.
